description: This file defines a single exported function `resolveDaemonContainerContext` which retrieves and returns a specific environment variable value related to container context, or null if not found.

methods.name: export function resolveDaemonContainerContext( resolveDaemonContainerContext
methods.description: Retrieves container context information from environment variables `OPENCLAW_CONTAINER_HINT` or `OPENCLAW_CONTAINER` and trims whitespace, returning null if neither is set.
